question: How many seconds will a boy take to run one complete round around a square field of side 25 metres, if he runs at a speed of 3 km/hr?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Distance = Perimeter of the square = 4 × 25 = 100 m

Speed in m/s = 3 × (5/18) = 5/6 m/s

Time taken = Distance ÷ Speed = 100 ÷ (5/6) = 120 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is 120 seconds.**
